type: Campaign Key Visual Main Visual System
goal: Create an anchor image for the main campaign of summer beverages that can also showcase three commonly used compositional derivatives within the same image, used for alignment with media agencies.

campaign.name: Coca-Cola Refreshing Summer 2026
campaign.claim: A bubble pauses the city's heat wave

visual_system.color_palette: Brand red + white + light gold bubble highlights

anchor_visual.description: A giant glass soda bottle with condensed water droplets is placed diagonally on a shallow depth of field beach wooden table, with a classic curve and no deformation, the background blurred into a summer seaside crowd and parasols; the left side of the image has 40% white space for Chinese claims and text labels
anchor_visual.composition: Bottle body occupies the center slightly to the right in vertical view, perspective slightly looking up enhances tension

visual_system.graphic_motif: Scattered minimalistic bubble dots and short arcs, repeating rhythm around the title without overshadowing the product.

claim_typography.font_style: Bold black sans-serif Chinese + slightly narrower European-style serif English sub-line
claim_typography.color: Deep red text + gold thin underline for rhythm

items: 1:1 square image, closer crop of the bottle body, claim at the top center
9:16 vertical screen, full height of the bottle, bottom leaving a silhouette of two hands holding a cup
16:9 landscape, layered bottle and waves split left and right, claim in the left third
derivative_layouts.rule: Three small sketches arranged in a light gray frame below the main image block, with scale annotations in each box

logo_placement.position: anchor and child version unify the position of the small text label in the lower right corner

must_keep: anchor shares the same color palette, bottle shape, and lighting direction as the three drafts
claim remains readable in small proportion sketches, not cut to the edges
The entire image does not contain any third-party logos unrelated to the beverage
avoid: The three-sketch style is not in the same dimensional feel as the main image
Text overlays at the densest highlight of the soda bottle.
